annotations.title: Extract Verbatim OCR Text from Document

description: Extract verbatim plain-text OCR transcription from a single PDF or image (PNG, JPEG, WEBP, TIFF; max 15 MB) with zero LLM rewriting or schema transformation. Routes digital PDFs through native text extraction and scanned documents through enterprise computer vision in memory. Use when you want the full raw text of contracts, letters, forms, or scans. Do NOT use when you need structured JSON fields (`extract_document_json`) or spreadsheet/CSV rows (`extract_document_table`). Consumes 1 credit per page with `api_key`, or 1 of 2 free daily anonymous extractions when omitted.

api_key.description: Optional Smart OCR API key (`ocr-tok_...`). Falls back to `x-api-key` or `Authorization: Bearer` header, then to the anonymous free tier (2 documents/day per IP).

file_base64.description: Base64-encoded document bytes (raw base64 or `data:<mime>;base64,...` URI, max 15 MB decoded). Mutually exclusive with `file_url` — provide exactly one.

file_name.description: Optional filename with extension (e.g., `"contract.pdf"`) for audit metadata. Defaults to `"document.pdf"`.

file_url.description: Public HTTP/HTTPS URL of the PDF, PNG, JPEG, WEBP, or TIFF document (max 15 MB). Mutually exclusive with `file_base64` — provide exactly one.

name: extract_document_text

processedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when OCR finished.

text.description: Verbatim OCR or native text extracted from all pages of the document.
